messages:
leon: Heads-up from staging: SLO tiles are showing "alert spikes" that don't match outgoing notifications. Owners see counts jump and then vanish even though routing and throttles prevented fanout. Screenshot in thread.
tanya: Repro steps: enable soft-thresholds on route /api/checkout, flood with brief error bursts. Console shows spikes and error-budget decreases, but notification backend reports zero deliveries.
mike: Sounds like a display vs routing mismatch. The UI computes burn from `display_count` returned by /slo/alerts-v1 which currently is raw events with EWMA smoothing applied. But notification routing evaluates rules later and drops or reroutes events (quota, tier routing).
leon: We should avoid misleading owners. Proposals: 1) server returns two numbers: `display_count` (raw+smoothed) and `outgoing_estimate` (post-routing estimate), 2) include `routing_reason` tags like `quota_dropped`, `backup_route_used`, `suppressed_by_silence`. UI shows outgoing_estimate as primary.
tanya: Also UX: add a subtle 'preview mode' toggle per-tenant: "Show raw signals (preview)" so SREs can inspect both modes. Default to outgoing_estimate for owners.
mike: Implementation notes: compute outgoing_estimate by simulating routing for the aggregation window using current policies (cheap, approximate) so it matches what will be sent. Flag behind `slo-display-v2` so we can canary.
nana: (oops meant ana) Telemetry ask: emit `slo.display.delta = display_count - outgoing_estimate` and a histogram of `routing_reasons` with tags. We want a grafana panel to compare raw vs estimate for canary cohort.
leon: Cache detail: frontend caches /slo/alerts-v1 for 20s; reduce TTL to 6s for tenant-scoped cards while canary is on. Also add a loading shimmer when we detect a change in routing policy.
tanya: Rollout plan: 1) server FF + metric, 2) console reads outgoing_estimate when present, 3) test on 5 canary tenants, 4) observe `slo.display.delta` and support tickets for 6 hours, 5) promote.
mike: Tests: overlapping routing policies, quota drops, tier-failover (primary->backup), and late-arriving events affecting EWMA. Also unit tests for the routing simulation to ensure monotonicity.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled for staging at 09:30 UTC tag= slo-display-v2-canary. Rollout checklist: feature flag, telemetry, UI banner "Using routing-aware counts (canary)", smoke tests, promote.
nana: I'll own the server PR and telemetry. @mike can you own the UI changes and the preview toggle copy?
mike: Yep. Sync 20m tomorrow 10:00 PT. Thanks all.
